title: Joomla Extension - vi-solutions - Missing access check in reload task in Visforms extension 1.0.0-5.6.4, 6.0.0-6.2.1 -…
description: A vulnerability in the Joomla Visforms extension versions 1.0.0 through 5.6.4 and 6.0.0 through 6.2.1 allows unauthenticated users to access restricted form data. The issue arises because the reload task does not properly check form and field access levels, enabling unauthorized retrieval of SQL field statement results from restricted forms.
